verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the full path. There is a spec: a SKILL.md directory that requires `name` and `description`, plus optional scripts. A guided skill creator asks what the skill does, when it should trigger, and whether it needs scripts, and a recorder can draft a skill from a demonstration. The built-in `@plugin-creator` meta-skill scaffolds `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` and a local marketplace entry for packaging, and a submission portal accepts skills-only plugins for publishing. A community user reports building custom Skills but does not specifically confirm the creator flow. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the skill-creator and plugin-creator flow works end to end.
